observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 102.» (L9) in the left margin.
body L16: the o of «quoties» is printed broken, only a sliver of it.

body L18, L19: «an–nayrūz» is printed in roman type here (italic on p. 67).
